description: 4-axis BCP-47 Chinese & Cantonese profiles, legacy tag aliases, locale path inference patterns, and source-code / markup / catalog anti-patterns.

zh-Hant-HK.primary_scope: Hong Kong UI ([設定]), Help documentation, enterprise/billing copy, and formal press

yue-Hant-HK.primary_scope: Hong Kong TTS/ASR, voice assistants, conversational UI, and Written Cantonese copy

zh-Hant-MO.primary_scope: Macau formal Traditional Chinese UI and statutory/commercial copy

zh-Hant-TW.primary_scope: Taiwan UI (「設定」), Help documentation, and Standard Mandarin Traditional prose

zh-Hans-CN.primary_scope: Mainland China UI (“设置”), Help documentation, and Putonghua Simplified prose

zh-Hans-SG.primary_scope: Singapore Simplified Chinese (華語) UI, statutory terms, and regional exonyms

zh-Hans-MY.primary_scope: Malaysia Simplified Chinese (華語) UI, media, and regional exonyms

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Parse with ICU ULocale.addLikelySubtags / Intl.Locale(tag).maximize() / Locale.forLanguageTag and inspect language + script + region
code_antipatterns.rationale: Splitting BCP-47 tags on '-' or '_' misinterprets 3-part script tags: 'zh-Hant-HK'.split('-')[1] yields 'Hant' instead of region 'HK'.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Resolve full script + region locale (e.g., Intl.Locale(tag).maximize(), ULocale.addLikelySubtags, or NSBundle.mainBundle.preferredLocalizations.firstObject)
code_antipatterns.rationale: Extracting only the primary language subtag collapses zh-Hans-CN, zh-Hant-TW, zh-Hant-HK, and zh-Hans-SG into bare 'zh' and discards script/region.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Check Locale.getScript() (with ULocale.addLikelySubtags fallback) and Locale.getCountry() alongside getLanguage()
code_antipatterns.rationale: Branching on locale.getLanguage().equals("zh") without inspecting script or region treats Traditional and Simplified Chinese identically.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Resolve full 4-axis BCP-47 profile (zh-Hant-HK, yue-Hant-HK, zh-Hant-MO, zh-Hant-TW, zh-Hans-CN, zh-Hans-SG, zh-Hans-MY) via script + region
code_antipatterns.rationale: Binary zh-CN vs. zh-TW ternaries erase Hong Kong/Macau glyph and legal differences, Singapore/Malaysia Simplified norms, and Cantonese.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Fall back zh-Hant-HK -> zh-Hant-MO -> zh-Hant-TW -> zh-Hant (never across script boundaries to zh-CN / zh-Hans)
code_antipatterns.rationale: Hong Kong and Macau use Traditional Chinese (Hant); falling back to zh-CN/zh-Hans breaks user script expectations.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Keep UI language (hl / Accept-Language / app locale) independent of geo/IP/TLD (gl / country)
code_antipatterns.rationale: A zh-Hant-HK or zh-Hant-TW user roaming in Mainland China or visiting a regional TLD must keep their explicit UI language and script.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Preserve source zh-Hant-HK / zh-Hant-TW tags end-to-end instead of coercing to zh-CN
code_antipatterns.rationale: Coercing Traditional source tags to zh-CN merges 1-to-many characters (乾/幹/干, 裏/裡/里, 發/髮) and corrupts regional terminology.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Use explicit regional/script Android resource qualifiers: values-zh-rCN, values-zh-rTW, values-zh-rHK, values-b+zh+Hans+SG, values-b+yue+Hant+HK
code_antipatterns.rationale: Bare res/values-zh/ is ambiguous on Android and matches Simplified and Traditional locales indiscriminately.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Maximize subtags (ULocale.addLikelySubtags) and check script ('Hans' vs 'Hant') plus region ('HK', 'MO', 'TW', 'CN', 'SG', 'MY')
code_antipatterns.rationale: Locale.SIMPLIFIED_CHINESE ('zh_CN') returns false for 'zh-Hans-CN', 'zh-Hans-SG', and 'zh-Hans-MY'; Locale.TRADITIONAL_CHINESE ('zh_TW') returns false for 'zh-Hant-HK' and 'zh-Hant-TW'.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Map Hong Kong/Macau spoken TTS/ASR surfaces to 'yue-Hant-HK' (or 'yue-HK' where engine-constrained)
code_antipatterns.rationale: 'zh-HK' and 'cmn-HK' invoke Mandarin synthesis/recognition on many speech engines instead of Cantonese (yue).

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Specify script and region in HTML/XML lang attributes: lang="zh-Hant-HK", lang="zh-Hant-TW", or lang="zh-Hans-CN"
code_antipatterns.rationale: Bare lang="zh" fails OpenType locl CJK glyph selection and screen-reader voice selection between Mandarin and Cantonese.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Pass an explicit regional/collation tag such as 'zh-Hans-CN-u-co-pinyin', 'zh-Hant-TW-u-co-zhuyin', or 'zh-Hant-HK-u-co-stroke'
code_antipatterns.rationale: Bare Intl.Collator('zh') defaults to Pinyin ordering, which surprises Traditional Chinese users expecting stroke-count or Zhuyin sorting.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Order locale-appropriate Chinese fonts (PingFang HK / Noto Sans HK, PingFang TC / Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei) ahead of Japanese fonts
code_antipatterns.rationale: Placing Japanese fonts before Chinese fonts in CSS font-family renders unified Han codepoints with Japanese Kanji glyphs (e.g., 直, 骨, 門, 曜) in Chinese UI.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Wrap non-translatable tokens in <xliff:g> / <ph> placeholders or mark whole non-translatable resources with translatable="false" instead of prose 'DO NOT TRANSLATE'
code_antipatterns.rationale: Free-text 'DO NOT TRANSLATE' notes in message descriptions are ignored by automated MT/QA checks; structural placeholder markup enforces token preservation.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Use Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact' }) or ICU CompactDecimalFormat
code_antipatterns.rationale: Chinese groups large numbers in myriads (萬 = 10^4, 億 = 10^8); hardcoded 1K/5M suffixes produce unnatural English compact units in Chinese UI.

code_antipatterns.suggestion: Use 'Country/Region' or 'Country or region' in source UI strings (localizing to 國家/地區, 國家或地區, 国家/地区)
code_antipatterns.rationale: Standalone 'Country' labels create geopolitical compliance bugs when listing territories such as Hong Kong (HK), Macau (MO), or Taiwan (TW).
